summary: Verification could not be completed: every source host (cna.com.tw, udn.com, tvbs.com.tw, ctee.com.tw, ylepb.gov.tw) failed to resolve from this network, so no figure was independently confirmed. The earlier researcher's numbers are kept as unverified leads. Largest reported offers: 新竹市 up to NT$29,500 scrap-and-replace and NT$50,500 low-income (unclear if central money is included; quota may be gone); 宜蘭縣 up to NT$27,300 swap and NT$19,000 new purchase; 南投縣 up to NT$27,300 swap; 雲林縣 NT$15,000 swap, NT$10,000 new; 彰化縣 NT$12,000 county top-up (deadline 2027-01-10). Do not publish these in a calculator until re-checked against the county 環保局 pages. Central 經濟部 support reportedly ends 2026-12-31.
